tables.name: Constituents
tables.description: This database provides an overview of various chemical constituents, detailing their names and purpose.

rows.Name: 5,13-docosadienoic acid
rows.Purpose: A type of fatty acid found in some plants and fish oils, it's involved in biological processes in the body.

rows.Name: 5-Eicosenoic acid
rows.Purpose: A fatty acid commonly found in some plant oils; it's a part of the skin's lipid barrier and helps maintain skin health.

rows.Name: Alkaloids
rows.Purpose: Naturally occurring compounds mainly found in plants; they often have potent effects on the body and can be used as medications or stimulants (like caffeine or morphine).

rows.Name: Alpha-linolenic acid
rows.Purpose: An essential omega-3 fatty acid found in plant sources like flaxseed; important for heart health and may reduce inflammation.

rows.Name: Amino Acids
rows.Purpose: The building blocks of proteins; they play critical roles in the body, including tissue repair, nutrient transport, and more.

rows.Name: Avenasterols
rows.Purpose: Compounds found in certain plant-based oils; they are known for their antioxidant properties and potential health benefits.

rows.Name: Behenic acid
rows.Purpose: A long-chain fatty acid found in some oils and fats; used as a conditioner and moisturizer in skin and hair products.

rows.Name: Beta-sitosterol
rows.Purpose: A plant-based substance similar to cholesterol; it might help reduce cholesterol levels and improve urinary symptoms related to an enlarged prostate.

rows.Name: Betacarotene
rows.Purpose: A red-orange pigment found in plants and fruits; the body can convert it into Vitamin A, important for vision, immunity, and overall health.

rows.Name: Calcium
rows.Purpose: An essential mineral crucial for building and maintaining strong bones and teeth; also important for muscle function, nerve signaling, and heart health.

rows.Name: Campesterol
rows.Purpose: A natural steroid found in many plants; thought to help reduce cholesterol levels in the body.

rows.Name: Carbon
rows.Purpose: A fundamental element that's the primary building block of all life and organic compounds; it's found in everything from diamonds to graphite.

rows.Name: Carotenes
rows.Purpose: Pigments found in plants that give them their bright red, yellow, or orange color; the body can convert them into vitamin A, essential for vision and immune function.

rows.Name: Carotenoids
rows.Purpose: A group of plant pigments that are powerful antioxidants; they're responsible for the vibrant colors of many fruits and vegetables and have various health benefits.

rows.Name: Carvacrol
rows.Purpose: A compound found in oregano oil and other plants; known for its antimicrobial properties and strong, warm odor.

rows.Name: Chlorophyll
rows.Purpose: The green pigment in plants that's crucial for photosynthesis, allowing plants to absorb energy from sunlight.

rows.Name: Coenzyme Q10
rows.Purpose: A substance similar to a vitamin, found in every cell of the body; important for energy production and may have antioxidant benefits.

rows.Name: Ergosterol
rows.Purpose: A type of steroid found in fungi; upon exposure to UV light, it converts to vitamin D2, essential for calcium absorption and bone health.

rows.Name: Erucic Acid
rows.Purpose: A monounsaturated omega-9 fatty acid found in some oils, like canola; used industrially and in some cases, as an ingredient in animal feed.

rows.Name: Faradiol
rows.Purpose: A compound found in certain plants with anti-inflammatory properties; often studied for its potential medicinal effects.

rows.Name: Ferulic acid
rows.Purpose: An antioxidant found in plant cell walls, known for protecting against damage caused by harmful molecules and UV light.

rows.Name: Flavanoids
rows.Purpose: A large group of plant compounds known for their antioxidant properties, helping to combat cell damage in the body.

rows.Name: Gamma tocopherol
rows.Purpose: A type of Vitamin E found in certain plant oils; known for its antioxidant properties and role in protecting cells from damage.

rows.Name: Gamma-linolenic acid
rows.Purpose: An omega-6 fatty acid found in certain plant-based oils; known for its anti-inflammatory effects and role in skin health.

rows.Name: Gamma-orzanol
rows.Purpose: A compound found in rice bran oil; believed to lower cholesterol and provide antioxidant effects.

rows.Name: Glycocides
rows.Purpose: Compounds formed from a sugar and another compound by a glycosidic bond; they have various roles in plants and therapeutic properties.

rows.Name: Gondoic acid
rows.Purpose: A monounsaturated fatty acid commonly found in fish oils and some plant oils; known for its potential health benefits in maintaining heart health.

rows.Name: Hydroxystearic acid
rows.Purpose: A fatty acid used in skincare and cosmetics for its moisturizing properties and ability to help form protective barriers on the skin.

rows.Name: Iron
rows.Purpose: An essential mineral crucial for making hemoglobin, a protein in red blood cells that carries oxygen around the body.

rows.Name: Lauric acid
rows.Purpose: A saturated fatty acid found in coconut oil and palm kernel oil; known for its antimicrobial properties and use in soap production.

rows.Name: Linoleic acid
rows.Purpose: An essential omega-6 fatty acid found in many vegetable oils; crucial for maintaining healthy skin and cell membranes.

rows.Name: Lipids
rows.Purpose: A group of naturally occurring molecules including fats, oils, and cholesterol; essential for storing energy and forming cell membranes.

rows.Name: Longifolene
rows.Purpose: A naturally occurring, fragrant chemical compound found in pine trees and other plants; used in perfumery and flavoring.

rows.Name: Lutein
rows.Purpose: An antioxidant found in leafy green vegetables and egg yolks; important for eye health and may protect against age-related eye diseases.

rows.Name: Magnesium
rows.Purpose: An essential mineral important for bone health, nerve and muscle function, and maintaining a steady heart rhythm.

rows.Name: Myristic acid
rows.Purpose: A type of saturated fatty acid found in coconut oil, palm oil, and some animal fats; used in the production of soaps and cosmetics.

rows.Name: Oleic Acid
rows.Purpose: A healthy monounsaturated fat found in olive oil and other sources; known for supporting heart health and reducing inflammation.

rows.Name: Omega 3
rows.Purpose: Essential fatty acids important for heart and brain health; found in fish oil, flaxseeds, and walnuts.

rows.Name: Omega 5
rows.Purpose: A polyunsaturated fatty acid found in pomegranate seeds; known for its potential antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.

rows.Name: Omega 6
rows.Purpose: Essential fatty acids important for brain function and growth; found in many vegetable oils and seeds.

rows.Name: Omega 9
rows.Purpose: Monounsaturated fats that can support heart health; found in olive oil and other vegetable oils.

rows.Name: Palmitic acid
rows.Purpose: A common saturated fatty acid found in animals and plants; used in food for energy and in cosmetics for its moisturizing properties.

rows.Name: Palmitoleic acid
rows.Purpose: A monounsaturated fatty acid commonly found in animal fats and macadamia oil; known for its potential benefits to skin and cholesterol levels.

rows.Name: Pantothenic acid
rows.Purpose: An essential vitamin important for the metabolism of food, as well as the production of hormones and cholesterol.

rows.Name: Phenols
rows.Purpose: Compounds found in plants that have antioxidant properties, helping to protect against cell damage and support overall health.

rows.Name: Phosphorus
rows.Purpose: An essential mineral important for the formation of bones and teeth, and also plays a role in how the body uses carbohydrates and fats.

rows.Name: Phytosterols
rows.Purpose: Compounds found in plant cell membranes; similar to cholesterol and thought to help lower cholesterol levels in the body.

rows.Name: Polyphenol gallic acid
rows.Purpose: A type of polyphenol with strong antioxidant properties; found in tea and other plants.

rows.Name: Polyphenols
rows.Purpose: A category of compounds naturally found in plants; known for their antioxidant properties and potential health benefits.

rows.Name: Potassium
rows.Purpose: An essential mineral that helps regulate fluid balance, muscle contractions, and nerve signals.

rows.Name: Protein
rows.Purpose: Essential nutrients made of amino acids; they are the building blocks of body tissue and serve as a fuel source.

rows.Name: Punicic acid
rows.Purpose: A type of fatty acid found in pomegranate seeds; known for its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties.

rows.Name: Ricinoleic acid
rows.Purpose: A fatty acid found in castor oil; known for its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.

rows.Name: Schottenol
rows.Purpose: A compound found in some plants, known for its potential antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.

rows.Name: Selenium
rows.Purpose: An essential mineral that plays a crucial role in metabolism and thyroid function and has antioxidant properties.

rows.Name: Sesamin
rows.Purpose: A compound found in sesame seeds; known for its antioxidant properties and potential to support heart health.

rows.Name: Spinasterol
rows.Purpose: A plant steroid believed to have anti-inflammatory and other health-promoting properties.

rows.Name: Squalane
rows.Purpose: A stable hydrocarbon found naturally in the skin, used in cosmetics for its moisturizing properties and ability to replenish the skin's lipid barrier.

rows.Name: Stearic acid
rows.Purpose: A saturated fatty acid found in many animal and plant fats; commonly used in the production of soaps and cosmetics.

rows.Name: Sterols
rows.Purpose: Compounds found in the cells of plants and animals, similar to cholesterol; plant sterols are known to help lower cholesterol levels.

rows.Name: Stigmasterol
rows.Purpose: A plant sterol with a structure similar to cholesterol; thought to help lower cholesterol levels and have anti-inflammatory properties.

rows.Name: Terpene alcohols
rows.Purpose: Compounds derived from terpenes, found in essential oils; known for their fragrance and potential therapeutic properties.

rows.Name: Terpene lactones
rows.Purpose: Compounds related to terpenes, found in certain plants; known for their potential cognitive and circulatory benefits.

rows.Name: Thymol
rows.Purpose: A compound found in thyme oil and other plants, known for its antiseptic and antifungal properties.

rows.Name: Thymoquinone
rows.Purpose: An active compound in black seed oil; recognized for its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anticancer properties.

rows.Name: Tocopherols
rows.Purpose: A group of fat-soluble compounds that include Vitamin E; known for their role in protecting cells from damage and supporting skin health.

rows.Name: Triterpenes
rows.Purpose: A class of chemical compounds found in plants; known for a wide range of potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antiviral properties.

rows.Name: Vitamin A
rows.Purpose: An essential vitamin important for vision, immune function, and skin health.

rows.Name: Vitamin B
rows.Purpose: A group of essential nutrients crucial for energy production, brain function, and cell metabolism.

rows.Name: Vitamin B1
rows.Purpose: A vitamin that helps convert nutrients into energy; important for nerve, muscle, and heart function.

rows.Name: Vitamin B2
rows.Purpose: A vitamin that helps the body break down carbohydrates, proteins, and fats to produce energy, and it allows oxygen to be used by the body.

rows.Name: Vitamin C
rows.Purpose: An essential nutrient and antioxidant; important for the repair of tissues and the enzymatic production of certain neurotransmitters. Also helps with immune system function.

rows.Name: Vitamin D
rows.Purpose: A fat-soluble vitamin that helps the body absorb calcium and phosphorus; important for bone health and immune function.

rows.Name: Vitamin E
rows.Purpose: A group of fat-soluble compounds that play a crucial role in protecting cells from damage; also supports immune function and skin health.

rows.Name: Vitamin K
rows.Purpose: An essential vitamin that plays a key role in blood clotting and bone metabolism.

rows.Name: Zinc
rows.Purpose: A mineral that's crucial for metabolism, immune function, and the repair of body cells.

rows.Name: p-cymene
rows.Purpose: A naturally occurring compound found in many essential oils; known for its aromatic properties and potential antioxidant effects.

rows.Name: t-anethole
rows.Purpose: A compound primarily found in anise, fennel, and other plants; recognized for its sweet, aromatic scent and potential health benefits, including antioxidant and antimicrobial properties.
